experiment_data.hypothesis: Per-DOF inverse-variance weighted loss will improve CRM by prioritizing high-precision DOFs (rotation/gripper), compared to uniform MSE

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python src/train_crm.py --benchmark object --loss_type perdof_weighted --epochs 50 --batch_size 32 --lr 1e-3 --obs_dim 960 --cache_dir /root/autodl-tmp/crm_cache_v5/ --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_loss_variants/perdof_weighted/ 2>&1 | tee /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/crm_loss_variants/perdof_weighted/train.log"
